gen-gf-autour-one-gf-georama: Georama opens its c wide and keeps its capitals low and modest. Autour One is the showy one, round and swell-free, while Georama quietly does the text-sized work of staying friendly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills its lines with a tall lowercase and a widely parted s. Autour One does the loud, rounded showing off, and Golos Text does the contemporary, approachable talking.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Autour One has a tube-like thickness that holds through every bend, and it makes a bold first impression. And Hedvig Letters Sans, with small letters nearly as tall as its capitals and a gap where each c ends, keeps a long page feeling approachable.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-heebo: Expressive from the first glance, Autour One draws its stems like dowels and its arcs like bent dowels. Heebo then supplies a tall, tidy text band.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur keeps wide gaps between its curve ends and stems, and its lines look like steel cable with no thick-thin shift. Over a long passage it feels modern and steady.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hind-madurai: Round, loud and friendly from the first glance. Hind Madurai brings s curves open wide at both ends, with stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon, which gives the pair its strongest quality: a bold heading beside a body that fills the line.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hind-mysuru: Chunky headline, tidy text. Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase tight toward ascender height and leaves each a with its mouth ajar, and that busy, upright texture is the strongest thing against Autour One.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hind-siliguri: Autour One is the expressive one, with a clear channel leading into each round letter and no hairline-to-stem shift. Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray of constant line weight, and gives its capitals just a gentle bump.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hind-vadodara: Clean, professional lines run through Hind Vadodara, whose thickness never changes with direction. And Autour One brings the boldness, so the pair's strongest quality is that its big open e and a sit beneath a display face.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-huninn: Autour One leads with a clear channel into each round letter and no hairline-to-stem shift. Huninn follows with lowercase bodies that rise close to cap height and crossbars as fat as their stems.
